bodyText:
There are several running docker containers with labels.
All logs records go through common transforms and then I need to split stream based on label.
But I can't find right condition for swimlanes transform
vector.toml
[sources.in]
  type = "docker"
  include_labels = ["com.atuko.log_shipping=junk", "com.atuko.log_shipping=elastic"]

[transforms.json]
  type = "json_parser"
  inputs = ["in"]
  drop_invalid = true

[transforms.remove_tokens]
  type = "lua"
  inputs = ["json"]
  version = "2"

  hooks.process = """
  function (event, emit)
    if event.log.request ~= nil then
      r = event.log.request:gsub('X%-System%-Token:.*', '')
      r = r:gsub('Authorization:.*', '')
      event.log.request = r
    end

    emit(event)
  end
  """

[transforms.split]
  type = "swimlanes"
  inputs = ["remove_tokens"]

  # Lanes
  [transforms.split.lanes.files]
    type = "check_fields"
    "com.atuko.log_shipping.eq" = "junk"

  [transforms.split.lanes.elastic]
    type = "check_fields"
    "com.atuko.log_shipping.eq" = "elastic"

[sinks.http]
  type = "http"
  inputs = ["split.files"]
  uri = "10.1.1.1:80"
  encoding.codec = "ndjson"

[sinks.elastic]
  type = "elasticsearch"
  inputs = ["split.elastic"]
  host = "10.1.1.1:9000"
  index = "vector-%F"
